title: Jump Game
prompt:
`nums[i]` is your maximum jump length from index `i`. Starting at index 0, can you reach the last index?

**Example**: `[2,3,1,1,4]` → `true`; `[3,2,1,0,4]` → `false` (everything funnels into the 0).

One greedy pass tracking the farthest reachable index.
hints: Track `reach` = the farthest index attainable so far.
If the loop arrives at an index beyond `reach`, you're stranded — return false.

solution.explanation: O(n)/O(1). The greedy claim: exact jump choices don't matter, only the reachable frontier — any index ≤ reach is attainable. Surviving the loop means the last index was within reach.
